content: For children aged 6 to 12 years, administer one tablet orally once daily or every six hours. For individuals older than 12 years, administer 1250 mg orally with 8 ounces of water every six hours, ensuring the total daily dose does not exceed 6 grams. Alternatively, 1250 mg can be taken orally with 8 ounces of water once daily or every six hours, with the same maximum daily dose restriction of 6 grams. Polycarbophil reduces the levels of demeclocycline by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Exercise caution and monitor the patient closely. Polycarbophil reduces the levels of doxycycline by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Exercise caution and monitor the patient closely. Exercise caution and monitor the patient closely. Polycarbophil may reduce the effects of sodium picosulfate through an unspecified interaction mechanism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Monitor the patient closely. Adverse effects associated with this product include abdominal fullness, flatulence, vomiting, stomach cramps, hypersensitivity reactions, bowel obstruction, appendicitis, dysphagia, fecal impaction, and rectal bleeding. Taking this product without adequate fluid intake may cause it to swell and obstruct the throat or esophagus, potentially leading to choking. Do not use this product if you have difficulty swallowing. If you experience chest pain, vomiting, difficulty swallowing, or breathing difficulties after taking this product, seek immediate medical attention. Consult a physician before using this product if you experience abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, or a sudden change in bowel habits lasting more than two weeks. If you are taking other medications, consult a healthcare professional, as laxatives may interfere with the absorption or efficacy of other drugs. Administer this product at least two hours before or after other medications. Do not use this product for more than seven days unless directed by a physician. Discontinue use and consult a physician if rectal bleeding occurs or if you fail to have a bowel movement after using this or other laxatives, as these symptoms may indicate a serious condition. Keep this product out of the reach of children. In the event of an overdose, seek medical assistance or contact a poison control center immediately. Regarding pregnancy, this product is not absorbed systemically and is considered safe for use during pregnancy. It is classified as Pregnancy Category NA. For lactating women, there is no available data, but due to the lack of systemic absorption, it is presumed safe for use during breastfeeding. In general, this product is considered acceptable for use. Controlled studies in pregnant women have shown no evidence of fetal risk.
